title: The All Inboxes circle counts important unread, and account counts can be changed or hidden
steps: With two accounts (fake data has two), look at the tray circle before the account pictures, hover it, then press Control-Command-S to show the sidebar

In Settings › General › Window › Account counts choose All unread in Inbox, then Off, then Important unread; each time look at the circle, the other account's picture and the sidebar's All Inboxes row
Right-click the circle and choose Hide count, then right-click it again and choose Show count
Press G A for All mail, then open Done from the sidebar; hover each title
expected: Important unread (default): the circle is the sum of each account's important unread (99+ above 99); its tooltip reads All Inboxes · N important unread ⌃0. All unread in Inbox: the whole-Inbox sum. Off: no number on any picture and the sidebar row shows ⌃0. Hide count turns counts off; Show count brings back Important unread. All mail and Done show no number; hovering gives the total.
